items.t: Polk County undercover operation leads to 281 arrests targeting human trafficking, child predators
items.x: A seven-day undercover operation led by the Polk County Sheriff's Office resulted in 281 arrests targeting human trafficking and child sexual predators.

items.t: Ex-Mickey Mouse actor tried to meet minor for sex, brought diapers, Polk sheriff says
items.x: Out of the hundreds arrested in a recent Polk County child predator sting, one suspect stood out for besmirching the good name of Mickey Mouse.

items.t: Disney workers, deputy and youth coach among 281 arrested in Polk County human trafficking sting
items.x: A massive, multi-agency undercover operation in Polk County led to the arrest of 281 people facing nearly 500 new criminal charges targeting online child predators and human trafficking operations.

items.t: Publix Advances $200M Warehouse Expansion in West Lakeland
items.x: Lakeland’s largest employer will expand its County Line Road distribution center to include a produce warehouse and return center.

items.t: Davenport youth football coach brought sex toys in Uber Eats bag to meet minor, sheriff says
items.x: Polk County Sheriff Grady Judd is set to discuss the details of an undercover operation targeting human trafficking, prostitution, and child sex predators Friday morning.

items.t: Día de los Muertos Market Returns to Lakeland Nov. 1
items.x: The second annual Día de los Muertos Market will be held at Haus 820 on Sunday, Nov. 1, from noon to 5 p.m.

items.t: Polk County’s Nonpartisan School Board Race Draws Partisan Support
items.x: In the District 3 runoff, political parties and PACs are financing campaign messages and supporting candidates in the race between Kate Wallace and Victor Sims.

items.t: South Florida Avenue Reconstruction Expected to Take More Than 3 Years
items.x: Lakeland’s $26.3 million project will bring wider sidewalks, improved crossings and a permanent three-lane design to Dixieland.

items.t: More Voting Myths, Debunked
items.x: Early voting begins Oct. 19, in Polk County. In part three of our series demystifying and debunking myths and misinformation about Florida elections, we're tackling the truth about vote by mail and polling places.

items.t: LPD Hosts National Prescription Drug Take Back Day Saturday
items.x: From 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. on Oct. 24, the Lakeland Police Department will host a drive-through drop-off for unwanted, unneeded, or expired medication.

items.t: Registration for LPD’s Cops for Kids Begins Oct. 26 and 27
items.x: The program has provided Christmas gifts and nurtured positive relationships with thousands of Lakeland children since it began in 2007.

items.t: Polk Disables Public Comments on County-Run Social Media Accounts
items.x: On Tuesday, Oct. 20, Polk County commissioners reached a unanimous vote to disable comments on all 21 county-run social media accounts, a decision that county officials say will curb misinformation and cut down on vulgarity.

items.t: 35th Annual Red Ribbon Run Coming Saturday, Oct. 31
items.x: The 35 annual Red Ribbon Run, promoting healthy, substance-free living, returns to Lake Mirror this Saturday, Oct. 31.

items.t: Polk Supervisor of Elections Debunks Social Media Ballot Rumors
items.x: LkldNow asks Melony Bell about social media claims that ballots might be rejected if written on by poll workers.

items.t: NASA telescope is on the verge of plunging back to Earth after failed rescue mission
items.x: The Swift Observatory is on the verge of plunging back to Earth after a failed rescue mission. U.S. Space Force predicts it will come crashing down any day.

items.t: Florida's 14th Congressional District: Kathy Castor faces Mike Beltran
items.x: Bay Area voters will decide in November whether to reelect Democratic U.S. Rep. Kathy Castor or send Republican challenger Mike Beltran to Congress in a closely watched race for Florida's 14th Congressional District.

items.t: DeSantis suspends Kissimmee mayor Jackie Espinosa following arrest on fraud, theft charges
items.x: Espinosa is accused of illegally applying for and receiving $90,000 worth of grants intended for businesses recovering from the pandemic.

items.t: How does daylight saving time impact your health?
items.x: Sleep is impacted, as well as metabolism, mental health and vascular health.

items.t: Pope Leo jokes he’s neutral on Villanova-Notre Dame matchup, but ‘Prevost has another opinion’
items.x: Pope Leo drew laughs by saying “the pope doesn’t take sides,” before hinting his former self still favors Villanova.

items.t: Last chance for early voting this weekend in Tampa Bay
items.x: If you're still waiting to cast your ballot in this year's midterm elections, you have only a few days left to do so.
